map.用水器具水效等级评估，对照GB 25501/30717/28378标准判定水效等: Water fixture efficiency-rating assessment: classify the rating against GB 25501/30717/28378 and compute annual water savings.
map.水效等级：按器具类型查标准阈值（一级 ≤ L1、二级 ≤ L2、三级 ≤ L3，: Water-efficiency grade: thresholds by fixture type (Grade 1 \u2264 L1, Grade 2 \u2264 L2, Grade 3 \u2264 L3; above Grade 3 is non-compliant). Daily usage = measured flow \u00d7 single-use duration \u00d7 daily uses (for sensor fixtures, usage = per-use volume = flow \u00d7 uses). Annual savings = (old fixture daily usage \u2212 new fixture daily usage) \u00d7 365; per-capita annual savings = annual savings \u00f7 users.
map.器具水效按国家标准分三级：实测流量落在对应阈值区间即判级，一级为高效节水、三级为: Fixture efficiency is graded in three national levels: the measured flow falling in the threshold interval determines the grade; Grade 1 is high-efficiency, Grade 3 is compliant, beyond Grade 3 is non-compliant. Savings vs. the old fixture: daily usage = unit usage \u00d7 duration \u00d7 uses; the difference \u00d7 365 gives annual savings, divided by users gives per-capita annual savings, used for payback evaluation of retrofit.
map.按器具类型（水嘴/坐便器/淋浴器/感应龙头等）录入实测流量，对照国标水效等级评定: Enter measured flow by fixture type (faucet, toilet, showerhead, sensor faucet, etc.) and rate Grade 1\u20133 or non-compliant against national standards.
map.节水改造前后对比：录入原器具流量，算出日/年节水量与人均年节水，评估改造成效与回: Pre/post retrofit comparison: enter the original fixture flow to compute daily/annual savings and per-capita annual savings, evaluating retrofit effect and payback.
map.公共建筑多器具普查：批量评估各器具水效，形成节水改造清单与优先级排序。: Multi-fixture survey in public buildings: batch-assess each fixture efficiency to form a retrofit list with priority ranking.
map.坐便器水效评估与节水量: Toilet efficiency assessment and water savings
map.某坐便器实测冲水量 4.5 L：一级阈值 4.0 L、二级 5.0 L、三级 6: A toilet with measured flush volume 4.5 L: Grade 1 threshold 4.0 L, Grade 2 5.0 L, Grade 3 6.0 L; 4.5 L falls in the Grade 2 interval, rated "Grade 2 (water-saving)". Original 9 L, 5 uses/day, 3 users: daily savings = (9 \u2212 4.5) \u00d7 5 = 22.5 L, annual \u2248 8.2 m\u00b3, per-capita \u2248 2.7 m\u00b3; use this to estimate retrofit payback.
map.水效等级怎么判定？: How is the efficiency grade determined?
map.按实测流量与器具对应国标阈值逐级比对：不超过一级阈值为一级（高效节水），依次为二: Compare measured flow with the fixture national thresholds level by level: not exceeding Grade 1 = Grade 1 (high-efficiency), then Grade 2 (water-saving), Grade 3 (compliant); exceeding Grade 3 = non-compliant (below standard). Thresholds differ by fixture (faucet, toilet, showerhead, etc.); the tool auto-switches by selected type.
map.感应类器具的日用水量怎么算？: How is daily usage calculated for sensor fixtures?
map.感应水嘴按「单次出水量 × 日均使用次数」计算；普通水嘴/淋浴器按「流量 × 单: Sensor faucets: daily usage = per-use volume \u00d7 daily uses. Ordinary faucets/showerheads: flow \u00d7 single-use duration \u00d7 uses. The tool auto-selects the algorithm by fixture type.
map.能直接算出省多少水费吗？: Can it directly compute the water-cost savings?
map.工具输出的是节水量（L 与 m³），水费需自行乘以当地水价。多数地区水价含阶梯与: The tool outputs water savings (L and m\u00b3); water cost requires multiplying by the local price. Most areas use tiered pricing with sewage fees; convert using the actual bill rate.
